Package com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.render

Class EnvironmentState

java.lang.Object
com.victorvalentim.zividomelive.render.EnvironmentState
public final class EnvironmentState extends Object
Shared logical state for the visual LDR environment background.

The PImage is a borrowed Processing-friendly source. Render passes resolve its Processing-managed OpenGL texture when needed and never take ownership of, or dispose, that texture. The shared scene-camera quaternion is visual orientation state only; orbit target and distance are deliberately excluded. This state contains no lighting, exposure, HDR, IBL, PBR, or AO data.

Since:
2.0.0

    • setSceneCameraOrientation

      public void setSceneCameraOrientation(Quaternion orientation)
      Sets the rotational component of the shared scene camera used by the Environment lookup. Target and distance deliberately remain outside the Environment state so the background stays infinite and translation-invariant.
      Parameters:
      orientation - scene-camera orientation, or null for identity
